ios.desc: SnapCal uses OpenAI's vision transformer to extract event details from photos of flyers, posters, and announcements. Simply snap a photo or select an image from your library, and SnapCal automatically identifies the event name, date, time, location, and recurring patterns. With one-tap integration with Apple Calendar and Google Calendar, you'll never manually type event details again. Perfect for conferences, campus events, and networking - just point, shoot, and add to your calendar in seconds.
